title: ...pick up a new DSLR or mirrorless camera
desc: Get your camera configured for sharp manual exposure shots.
todos: Format memory card inside camera menu settings before shooting.
Set photo output quality to RAW + JPEG for maximum editing flexibility.
Configure Autofocus (AF) mode to Single-Point AF for crisp subject targeting.
Attach neck/wrist strap securely to prevent accidental drop damage.
Practice Exposure Triangle basics: ISO, Aperture (f-stop), and Shutter Speed.
